title: PHILLIPS SACHEM Carbon Fiber Road Bike 2025
notes: The current regional retailer page identifies the 2025 SACHEM family and claims 8.5 kg complete-bike weight. It specifies a carbon frame, carbon fork and carbon aero seatpost; the 24-speed top configuration is 2×12 with a carbon integrated cockpit and ShunTai full hydraulic brakes. ShunTai or SENSAH shifting, a SENICX crank and a Rihui 12-speed cassette are listed without fixed part numbers. Stock CST 700×28C tires do not establish maximum clearance. The retailer warns that components and measured weight may vary by configuration and production batch.
